listing_source_id.description: The id of the ListingSource you qualified, such as ls_01...

qualification.description: What you decided with qualify_source; NOT_DECIDED when it refused or you could not call it.

label.description: The label your decision set, or NONE.

label_effect.description: The label_effect qualify_source answered; NONE when you decided nothing.

other_reason.description: For the label OTHER, the reason in two to four lower-case words; empty otherwise.

summary.description: What you read and why you decided so, naming the URLs.
